protocol.sampling: Unmodified Environment circle/random sampler for each frozen world seed. All128 episodes retained in seed-list order, including failures; no near-goal initialization, filtering, validation seeds or simulator-only features.
protocol.information_boundary: Only local9 plus known calibration and own command/observation history enter teacher; inferred wall/body hypotheses are not true poses/IDs/classes/counts. Actor data remains local9/task4, no teacher latent state or geometry inputs.
protocol.collection_gate: At least90percent official successes AND90percent final holds using unchanged numeric gates. All safety attempts/failures reported; no data filtering. This is teacher-source eligibility only, never learned acceptance.

training_if_qualified.validation: Final epoch80 only: five circle/random development seeds2001/2003/2011/2017/2027, original thresholds and no teacher. Require5/5 successes AND5/5 final holds before any larger gate or RL. No automatic extension, no default promotion.
